verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page says it ships a built-in set of utilities including Clocks, Weather and Maps, which covers the core of the story. Calendar is only implied, through the online-accounts integration that brings an online calendar to the desktop. Missing for 10: an explicit mention of a bundled calendar app, detail on what each utility can do, and independent or hands-on confirmation that these apps are present out of the box.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can rely on built-in utilities like calendar, weather, maps, and clock apps out of the box

citations.quote: Fedora Workstation includes a great set of utilities, like Clocks, Weather and Maps.
bring your online calendar, contacts and data to the desktop with online accounts
